text:
Ana: Quick scope call — we must lock the April MVP slice. I have a cut proposal.
Devon: shoot.
Ana: Keep: runtime perf work, core REST API, basic model pin by id (API + CLI), canary core. Cut: full pin-management UI, tag filtering in UI, embeddings eviction dashboard, and automated eval/regression alerts.
Kai: Agree. Full pin UI adds 3 FE sprints. Backend proto is done.
Raj: Pilots asked about rollback. Can we guarantee fast rollback without UI?
Devon: Yes — POST /pins/rollback + tiny CLI wrapper. Add audit logs (request_id + actor). Cuts ~10 FE-days.
Marie: UX: we'll add a slim header in the console showing current pinned model and a link to CLI docs. Minimal friction for pilots.
Ana: Canary: implement toggle + percentage slider only; advanced rollouts to v1.
Kai: I'll run the safety tests to prove rollback <3 minutes and canary adds <500ms.
Devon: Estimates: CLI+header+toggle = 10 dev-days; rollback endpoint = 4 dev-days; safety tests = 6 dev-days. Total ~20 dev-days.
Raj: I'll notify pilots (@acme_pilot @greenleaf_pilot) and ask for sign-off.
release-bot: Reminder: milestone freeze in 7 business days. last build cutoff: 1842105400.
Ana: Action items: Devon confirm estimates EOD; Kai validate SLAs; Marie draft header & CLI docs; Raj get pilot approval. I'll mark UI items v1.
Marie: Note — header must state "pinned models are global to tenant".
Devon: Also ensure rollback audit trail retention is recorded for compliance. Low lift.
Ana: Lock scope by EOD tomorrow unless pilots push back. Closing for now.
